articles.description: NEW YORK, Oct. 26 (Xinhua) -- U.S. stocks closed higher on Monday, with technology shares leading a rebound from last week's selloff as oil prices pulled back on hopes of easing Middle East tensions.

articles.title: Bhopal Metro Work Triggers 22-Day Traffic Diversions Between ITI Crossing And Piplani Petrol Pump From October 27, Check Alternative Routes
articles.description: Traffic diversions will be enforced between ITI Crossing and Piplani Petrol Pump Crossing in Bhopal from October 27 to November 17 for Metro construction. Commuters travelling towards Prabhat Crossing, JK Road, Minal, Govindpura and Awadhpuri must use designated alternative routes. Separate diversions have been announced for heavy and light vehicles.
